answer.summary: Kevin Aluwi says a strong brand moves a consumer business beyond a merely transactional relationship: it creates associations that can become part of customers’ identity and support loyalty competitors may not easily sway with discounts or extra features. sections.heading: What a strong brand does
sections.content: Aluwi describes brand as one of the two most important things in a consumer business, after product. A strong brand creates associations in customers’ minds that transcend the typically transactional or utilitarian relationship with a business and can become part of a person’s identity. As a result, loyalty can go beyond a relationship easily swayed by discounts or competitors’ additional features; he points to Apple fans and Nike sneakerheads as examples.

sections.heading: Why it mattered to Gojek
sections.content: Aluwi says Gojek built a strong brand for consumers, drivers, and merchants, and that it was a major reason the company survived despite being seriously underfunded. He says Gojek might not have reached escape velocity beyond its scrappy early stage without its brand efforts, and credits them with helping maintain its leadership in Indonesia.
